title: KEINE NUTZERAKTION ERFORDERLICH
message: RigWeave orchestration is healthy and fail-closed. Persistent-session Router V2 has STATIC and bounded REAL lifecycle PASS; persistent end-to-end send/URL-capture and PC-pool REAL gates remain pending and are not treated as ACTIVE workers.
action: Keine Nutzeraktion erforderlich. Release/runtime work remains package slimming; production deployment remains separately gated by explicit authorization.

director.detail: Technical SSOT and both Board lanes reviewed. P1 package slimming remains the single release/runtime workpoint. RigWeave domain drafts are queued for review/integration; INT-001 remains blocked pending prerequisite reviews. Router V2 persistent-session lifecycle evidence is accepted only at its stated level; no competing Windows/runner action was started.

workers.detail: 0 genuinely ACTIVE uniquely routed persistent worker sessions. READY, READY_FOR_REVIEW and closed_resumable sessions are not counted active. CHATROUTER-001 still requires bounded persistent end-to-end send/URL-capture before canonical enable; PCPOOL-001 REAL concurrency remains pending.
